brief.topic: A Distance Hidden in a Quiet Gap

s01: A sound reaches the cliff and comes back.
The quiet gap between the two sounds contains a distance.
Listen to this one-second round trip.
The pulse has to travel both ways.
Half the waiting time belongs to the outward journey.
The other half belongs to the return.
At twenty degrees Celsius, the speed of sound is about three hundred and forty-three metres per second.
A one-second echo delay puts this cliff about one hundred and seventy-two metres away.
We divide by two because the sound covers the distance twice.
Move the listener halfway toward the same cliff.
The round trip is now half as long.
Hear how the reply arrives sooner.
Distance is sound speed times delay, divided by two.
This model keeps the air still and the source and cliff stationary during each pulse.
Our tones are synthetic markers, not field recordings.
Even a moment of waiting can tell us the shape of a place.

scenes.narration:
A sound reaches the cliff and comes back. The quiet gap between the two sounds contains a distance. Listen to this one-second round trip.

The pulse has to travel both ways. Half the waiting time belongs to the outward journey. The other half belongs to the return.

At twenty degrees Celsius, the speed of sound is about three hundred and forty-three metres per second. A one-second echo delay puts this cliff about one hundred and seventy-two metres away. We divide by two because the sound covers the distance twice.

Move the listener halfway toward the same cliff. The round trip is now half as long. Hear how the reply arrives sooner.

Distance is sound speed times delay, divided by two. This model keeps the air still and the source and cliff stationary during each pulse. Our tones are synthetic markers, not field recordings. Even a moment of waiting can tell us the shape of a place.
